Year 1, 10.8% of cap: $11.8M at the 2019-20 cap versus $18.9M in 2027-28. Year 2, 11.1%: $12.1M at the 2020-21 cap versus $20.5M in 2028-29. Year 3, 11.3%: $12.7M at the 2021-22 cap versus $22.0M in 2029-30. Year 4, 11.5%: $14.2M at the 2022-23 cap versus $23.5M in 2030-31.
